records.jp: 伶那さん、大丈夫～？
records.en_original: Doing okay over there, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: Doing okay over there, Rena?
records.en: Doing okay over there, Rena-san?

records.jp: 大丈夫だって！<CR>私のことは気にしなくていいから、ほんとに！
records.en_original: I told you, I'm fine! There's no reason to worry about me!
records.en_auxiliary: I told you, I'm fine! There's no reason to worry about me!
records.en: I told you, I'm fine!<CR>You really don't need to worry about me!

records.jp: ま、ならいいけど～
records.en_original: If you say so!
records.en_auxiliary: If you say so!
records.en: If you say so!

records.jp: どう、きらら？
records.en_original: How are you doing, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: How are you doing, Kirara?
records.en: How are you doing, Kirara?

records.jp: 歩いてると、記憶が流れ込んでくる。<CR>不思議な感覚……――
records.en_original: The memories are flooding in as we walk. It's quite the unusual feeling...
records.en_auxiliary: The memories are flooding in as we walk. It's quite the unusual feeling...
records.en: As Kirara walks, memories flow into her.<CR>It is a strange sensation...—

records.jp: 久野さんは、次の県知事選で<CR>立候補なさらないんですか？
records.en_original: Will you be running for governor in the next election, Mr. Kuno?
records.en_auxiliary: Will you be running for governor in the next election, Mr. Kuno?
records.en: Kuno-san, will you not run<CR>in the next gubernatorial election?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 娘さんの力のおかげで、有名な政治家さんも<CR>久野さんを贔屓にしてくださっているじゃないですか
records.en_original: Thanks to your daughter's powers, you've gained the support of several well-known politicians.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks to your daughter's powers, you've gained the support of several well-known politicians.
records.en: Thanks to your daughter's power, even famous politicians<CR>look favorably upon you, Kuno-san.

records.jp: いろいろ後ろ盾を得られると思いますよ
records.en_original: I'm sure you could use that to your advantage.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure you could use that to your advantage.
records.en: I think you will be able to gain all sorts of powerful backers.

records.jp: 神託を授かった地域の者も<CR>きっと賛同してくれるはずです
records.en_original: The people in regions that received the oracle's blessing will surely back you as well.
records.en_auxiliary: The people in regions that received the oracle's blessing will surely back you as well.
records.en: The people in the regions that received the oracle<CR>will surely support you as well.

records.jp: もちろん、狙うつもりですよ
records.en_original: I will, of course, be running.
records.en_auxiliary: I will, of course, be running.
records.en: I will, of course, be running.

records.jp: ただ、娘の力で支持を得ている、なんて<CR>対立候補に言われるわけにはいきませんから
records.en_original: That being said, I can't let my opponent say that my daughter is the only reason I'm being endorsed.
records.en_auxiliary: That being said, I can't let my opponent say that my daughter is the only reason I'm being endorsed.
records.en: But I cannot allow my opponent to say<CR>that I gained support through my daughter's power.

records.jp: 使いどころは、慎重に……
records.en_original: I must be cautious of how to use her.
records.en_auxiliary: I must be cautious of how to use her.
records.en: I must be cautious of how to use her.

records.jp: 今の、さっき言ってたパパ同士の会話かな？
records.en_original: Was that a conversation between your dad and the mayor?
records.en_auxiliary: Was that a conversation between your dad and the mayor?
records.en: Was that the conversation between the two Papas you mentioned earlier?

records.jp: うん。どこかで聞いた会話だと思う
records.en_original: Yes, I believe I overheard it at some point.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I believe I overheard it at some point.
records.en: Yes. Kirara thinks she overheard it somewhere.

records.jp: 県知事選って……久野さんのお父さんがってこと？
records.en_original: Your father was running for governor?
records.en_auxiliary: Your father was running for governor?
records.en: The gubernatorial election... You mean your Papa was running, Kuno-san?

records.jp: パパは政治家だった。<CR>辺境の村だから、そんなに大きな力はなかったけど
records.en_original: He was a politician. Though because of the remote nature of our village, he had little power.
records.en_auxiliary: He was a politician. Though because of the remote nature of our village, he had little power.
records.en: Papa was a politician.<CR>But because it was a remote village, he did not have much power.

records.jp: なるほど、だから村長と仲良しなんだね
records.en_original: That makes sense that he's friends with the mayor then.
records.en_auxiliary: That makes sense that he's friends with the mayor then.
records.en: I see. So that is why he was friends with the mayor.

records.jp: でもなんか、“利用”とか……
records.en_original: But he said something about using you...
records.en_auxiliary: But he said something about using you...
records.en: But he said something about using you...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes...
records.en: Yes...

records.jp: パパは――
records.en_original: My dad...
records.en_auxiliary: My dad...
records.en: Papa—

records.jp: きららにはとても優しかった。<CR>美味しいご飯も食べさせてくれた
records.en_original: He was very kind to me. He always made sure I got to eat my favorites foods.
records.en_auxiliary: He was very kind to me. He always made sure I got to eat my favorites foods.
records.en: He was very kind to Kirara.<CR>He also let Kirara eat delicious meals.

records.jp: パパもママも幸せそうだった。<CR>きららも、それでいいと思ってた
records.en_original: Both my parents seemed happy. I thought everything was fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Both my parents seemed happy. I thought everything was fine.
records.en: Papa and Mama both seemed happy.<CR>Kirara thought that was enough.

records.jp: この時はまだ、地位とか権力とか、<CR>そういうことは何も分かっていなかったから
records.en_original: I didn't know anything about politics, power, or status.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't know anything about politics, power, or status.
records.en: Kirara did not understand anything<CR>about status or power back then.

records.jp: 久野さん……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara...
records.en: Kuno-san...

records.jp: この頃から生活が普通じゃなくなっていって……<CR>きららは、それを他人事みたいに思ってた
records.en_original: It was around this time that my life changed. Though I didn't particularly care at first.
records.en_auxiliary: It was around this time that my life changed. Though I didn't particularly care at first.
records.en: From around that time, Kirara's life stopped being normal...<CR>but Kirara regarded it as though it were someone else's problem.

records.jp: 神の使いなんて言われても、実感がなくて……
records.en_original: People would say I was special and an oracle, but I didn't feel special.
records.en_auxiliary: People would say I was special and an oracle, but I didn't feel special.
records.en: Even when people called Kirara a messenger of god, it did not feel real...

records.jp: そりゃそうだよね……
records.en_original: You were just a kid after all...
records.en_auxiliary: You were just a kid after all...
records.en: You were just a kid after all...

records.jp: あの時のパパは……なんだか、<CR>憑りつかれたみたいに必死で、ちょっと怖かった
records.en_original: But then my father... It's like he become possessed, I was afraid of him.
records.en_auxiliary: But then my father... It's like he become possessed, I was afraid of him.
records.en: Papa was so desperate back then...<CR>almost as though he were possessed. It frightened Kirara a little.

records.jp: 県知事選って言葉も、<CR>それと関係してるみたいでしたね
records.en_original: It must have been because of the election.
records.en_auxiliary: It must have been because of the election.
records.en: That mention of the gubernatorial election<CR>seems to have been connected too.

records.jp: きっと、たくさんの人から認められることは、<CR>パパにとってすごく大事なことで――
records.en_original: I believe it was important for my father to feel accepted by others.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe it was important for my father to feel accepted by others.
records.en: Being recognized by many people<CR>must have been extremely important to Papa—

records.jp: それに、きららの存在はうってつけだったんだと思う
records.en_original: And I was a means to that end.
records.en_auxiliary: And I was a means to that end.
records.en: And Kirara's existence must have been perfect for that.
